title: Why Mice Are No Bigger
year_evidence: 扉に『PUBLISHED BY THE AMERICAN FOLK-LORE SOCIETY … 1924』、序文の署名に『April, 1924.』
text:
Richard Morgan, Santa Cruz Mountains.

Deh is a man de name of Robin Mice-rat gwine to his uncle house. Him
an’ de uncle stay dere in dark de whole time. When him gwine away, he
tell de uncle good-by an’ tak a stick an’ he lick ’e uncle. At dis time
he went to our Savior an’ said he want to turn big man, so de Savior
tell him say if he wan’ to turn big man he mus’ go an’ kill his oldest
uncle. So, as he never died, he went back de nex’ night. So him an’ his
uncle talking an’ his uncle said to him, “Dat fellow Robin come here
las’ night; when him gwine away, tak a stick an’ lick me in de head.
But, me pickney, if a heah (pointing to the temple) him ketch me, de
fellow would a got me.” So as de uncle show him de place, as him get
up, meet his uncle at de said place, kill him ’tiff dead.

Nex’ day he went to his Savior fe let him turn big man. De Savior said
to him, “You little bit of man go kill you’ oldest uncle, den if me let
you turn bigger you will do worse!” So from dat day das de reason let
you see mice don’t bigger to dis day.

When him gwine away, he tell de uncle good-by an’ tak a stick an’ he lick ’e uncle. So, as he never died, he went back de nex’ night. So him an’ his uncle talking an’ his uncle said to him, “Dat fellow Robin come here las’ night; when him gwine away, tak a stick an’ lick me in de head. But, me pickney, if a heah (pointing to the temple) him ketch me, de fellow would a got me.” So as de uncle show him de place, as him get up, meet his uncle at de said place, kill him ’tiff dead.

Nex’ day he went to his Savior fe let him turn big man. De Savior said to him, “You little bit of man go kill you’ oldest uncle, den if me let you turn bigger you will do worse!” So from dat day das de reason let you see mice don’t bigger to dis day.
語り手 リチャード・モーガン(サンタクルス山地)

ロビン鼠という名の男が、叔父の家へ行った。叔父と二人、ずっと暗がりのなかにいた。帰るとき、叔父に別れを告げてから、棒を取って叔父を殴った。このとき男は救い主のところへ行って、大きな男になりたいと言った。すると救い主は、大きな男になりたいなら、いちばん年上の叔父を殺してこいと言った。それで叔父が死ななかったので、男は翌晩また行った。叔父と話していると、叔父が言った。「あのロビンって奴がゆうべここへ来てな。帰りぎわに棒を取って、おれの頭を殴っていった。だがな坊主、もしここを(とこめかみを指して)やられていたら、あいつはおれを仕留めていたろうよ」。叔父がその場所を教えてくれたので、男は立ち上がりざま、まさにその場所を狙って、叔父を打ち殺した。
翌日、男は救い主のところへ行って、大きな男にしてくれと言った。救い主は言った。「おまえはこんな小さな身で、いちばん年上の叔父を殺した。それでもっと大きくしてやったら、もっとひどいことをするだろう!」 その日から、鼠が今日まで大きくならないのは、そのわけである。
